svg.text: LAUNCH FILM · STORYBOARD V2 · SAAS LAUNCH CUT
Cuts on the downbeat. Hold 1.5s. The full stop pulses green once.
Hard cut to the second half.
Statement in grey: "You don't assemble." The scattered UI fragments from the hook shot
drift away behind it and dissolve.
Fragments fall out of frame with gravity; type stays.
Silence; a single button fades up.
Macro on the Approve button in brew Studio, cursor arriving. The finished file name
sits beside it: panama-canal_final.mp4 · Ready to upload.
Rack focus from file name to button. Click. A green ring blooms out and becomes the
One crisp click. The brew signature starts.
Ring opens into the end card.
brew logo in the viewfinder brackets. "Your first video is free." CTA button "Send us
a script →". scalewithbrew.com. Light beams drift.
Brackets close in; logo letters rise; CTA button pops with overshoot. Hold 2.5s. Cut
to black on the final note.
